headline: Spa and Wellness Therapist
summary: Spa and wellness therapist with three years at a Valenzuela wellness centre. I give massage and body treatments, run stretching and fitness sessions, assess each client's needs and limits, and keep a loyal client list through good care and follow-up. I also handle bookings and front-desk questions.

experience.title: Spa and Wellness Therapist
bullets: Give about six massage and body treatments a day and adjust each one to the client's health and preferences.
Run weekend stretching and light fitness sessions for regular clients.
Offer grooming services such as foot spa and hand care for packages.
Book appointments and follow up regular clients, who make up 60% of my schedule.

experience.title: Salon Assistant
bullets: Assisted with manicure, pedicure and foot spa services.
Greeted clients, answered calls and booked appointments.
